build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Revision history: v1 (commit b3cd8b2) was a night storefront exterior with only a celeste accent in the text layer -- client asked for a real Guatemalan symbol and a scene that reads as a barbershop, since the chairs seen through the storefront glass didn't read as barber chairs. v2 (commit ea3af4a) fixed both with a moody night-lit barbershop interior (classic barber chair, mirror, styling station with visible tools) plus a Guatemalan flag hanging on the wall as the one full-color element over an otherwise black-and-white duotone photo -- same 'deliberate brand exception' pattern as posts/instagram/mundial-bandera-argentina/ and posts/instagram/dia-partido-camiseta/. v3 (this revision): client found v2 'aburrido' and 'oscuro' and asked for more color and a background that isn't dark. Backgrounds regenerated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (feed at aspect-ratio 3:4 / resolution 2K, story at 9:16 / 2K) as the same barbershop interior -- same barber chair, mirror, styling-station tools, and Guatemalan flag -- but now shot in full natural color with bright daylight instead of a moody night duotone treatment, and with colorful papel picado paper bunting (traditional Guatemalan cut-paper banners in pink, orange, green, yellow, sky-blue) strung across the ceiling and mirror frame for a festive feel. This is no longer a 'duotone + one full-color exception' image -- the whole photo is in natural color now, so that brand-exception framing no longer applies to this post; design-system.md's duotone/gold-key-light rule is deliberately set aside here for a celebratory exception, same spirit as the color exceptions already precedented in mundial-bandera-argentina/ and dia-partido-camiseta/, just extended to the full frame instead of one element. The v1 exterior and v2 night-barbershop backgrounds are both kept for reference at raw/bg-v1-exterior*.png and raw/bg-v2-night-barbershop*.png. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html), unchanged since v2: celeste (#4997D0) pill, headline highlight word, and a thin celeste/bone/celeste flag-rule divider under the headline, echoing the flag's own colors in the now-bright photo. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). This is a purely commemorative post (no hours, no price, no booking CTA) -- distinct from the operational posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ post about special hours on the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: Orgullosamente / Guatemaltecos
